title: The Session
tagline: The Session is a DApp that builds a safe space for users and health professionals, where they can create support groups.
description:
The Session, where technology embraces the human, is a DApp that builds safe spaces for users and healthcare professionals to establish text-based therapy groups. It is a platform planned to break the barriers and stigmas surrounding mental health. 

It brings healthcare professionals with the latest Web3 technologies to provide assistance to individuals regardless of their time zone or social situation, ensuring that therapy is received anonymously and free of charge.

Our purpose is to nurture a community that develops its human side alongside technology, allowing users to discover groups on various topics and schedules; sustained by common values and authentication of digital identities.
how_its_made:
This DApp is powered by: 

Scroll: Network and smart contracts | Preparation of contracts at lower costs, shorter block times, zero knowledge, and higher throughput.

Push: Core technology | Communication between patients and professionals will be broadcasted through this protocol. 

Other technologies: 
-Figma: UX/UI
-Next.js: Frontend 
-Rainbowkit / Wagmi / ethers.js: Web3 interactions with the frontend
